title: REMUS AUVs
description: Documented public autonomous underwater vehicle (WHOI / Hydroid (Kongsberg)) for the Underwater Robot Mission Engine capability area.
body:
REMUS AUVs is a documented autonomous underwater vehicle from WHOI / Hydroid (Kongsberg). The REMUS family of AUVs: the workhorse subsea survey robots for mine countermeasures, science, and oil & gas.

How it works: It works by computing the lawnmower path: ceil(width / swath) passes times the field depth, plus turn segments.

Documented uses of this capability area include warehouse automation fleets, surgical robotics, autonomous laboratories, drone delivery networks, and subsea exploration.
